_note: KC-0264: what one model call costs Clawco, the one source the model proxy (sky/src/model/) prices its ledger from (AGENTS §0 r6). Prices are USD per million tokens, which is the same number as micro-USD per token. A model is priced in tiers by prompt length (input + cache reads + cache writes, the provider's own rule); the first tier whose opTilPromptTokens covers the prompt applies, null = no upper bound. Each provider (udbyder) has its base URL ({region} is filled in from region or SKY_AWS_REGION; Sky refuses to switch the proxy on unless docs/legal/behandlinger.json lists a provider whose vaerter cover that host), maps Clawco's model ids to its own ids and adds its surcharge in percent (Bedrock's EU geographic inference profile: +10 %). Which models a plan includes, and its monthly cap, live in config/priser.json (planer.*.inkluderetModel).

anthropic._note: Anthropic's own API (global routing, no EU region).

bedrock._note: Claude in Amazon Bedrock through the bedrock-runtime endpoint (InvokeModelWithResponseStream, SigV4) in eu-central-1 with the EU geographic cross-region inference profile eu.anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5: CONFIRMED by AWS' model card (read 2026-11-03: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-card-anthropic-claude-haiku-5-5.html). In eu-central-1 Haiku 5.5 is served only this way: the bedrock-mantle Messages endpoint has no cross-region profiles and offers it in-region only in us-gov-west-1 (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/endpoints.html). The EU profile routes and processes only within the six EU regions eu-central-1, eu-north-1, eu-south-1, eu-south-2, eu-west-1, eu-west-3 (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/geographic-cross-region-inference.html). The +10 % surcharge is Anthropic's statement that regional/geographic endpoints carry a 10 % premium (the pricing page under kilde); AWS' own price table did not render, so the AWS figure is ASSUMED to match until read there.
